settlementRules.description:
In the upcoming NFL football game between Falcons and Buccaneers, scheduled for November 1 at 1:00 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Falcons" if the Falcons win the game by 10 or more points.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Buccaneers".

Overtime is included if played.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

settlementRules.description:
In the upcoming NFL football game between Colts and Jaguars, scheduled for November 1 at 1:00PM ET:
This market will resolve to "Colts" if Colts win the game.
This market will resolve to "Jaguars" if Jaguars win the game.
Overtime is included if played.
If the game ends in a tie, this market will resolve 50-50.
If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.
If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

This market will resolve to "Titans" if the Titans win the game by 5 or more points.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Bengals".

Overtime is included if played.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Ravens".

Overtime is included if played.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

settlementRules.description:
In the upcoming NFL football game between Cardinals and Cowboys, scheduled for November 1 at 1:00 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Cowboys" if the Cowboys win the game by 7 or more points.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Cardinals".

Overtime is included if played.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

settlementRules.description:
In the upcoming NFL football game between Chargers and Rams, scheduled for November 1 at 4:05PM ET:
This market will resolve to "Chargers" if Chargers win the game.
This market will resolve to "Rams" if Rams win the game.
Overtime is included if played.
If the game ends in a tie, this market will resolve 50-50.
If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.
If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

settlementRules.description:
In the upcoming NFL football game between Chiefs and Broncos, scheduled for November 1 at 4:25 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Chiefs" if the Chiefs win the game by 8 or more points.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Broncos".

Overtime is included if played.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

This market will resolve to "Seahawks" if the Seahawks win the game by 3 or more points.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Bears".

Overtime is included if played.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
